newsitem.title: PERU: Ten firms interested in Peru's Yauricocha mine.
newsitem.headline: Ten firms interested in Peru's Yauricocha mine.

text.p: Ten companies from countries including Peru, Canada and Mexico have bought biddding details ahead of next week's auction of state-run Peruvian polymetallic mine Yaurichocha.

"Ten companies have bought the information, although that does not imply they will present offers on Monday," said Enrique Olivares, spokesman for Centromin - the state mining company that owns Yauricocha - without naming the firms.
The winner of the auction of Yauricocha, which has a $10 million base price, will be announced on Friday, September 13.
The auction winner will be obliged to invest at least $18 million within three years in the mine, which lies 220 miles (350 km) southeast of Lima.
Yauricocha, which currently produces 30,000 tonnes of mineral per month, has proven and probable reserves of 2.8 million tonnes and potential reserves of six million tonnes.

The proven reserves have grades of 1.1 percent for copper, 2.8 percent for lead and 5.3 percent for zinc. The mineral also contains 132 grams of silver and 0.8 grams of gold per tonne, according to the state miner.
Following the sale of Yauricocha, Centromin plans to auction in October its Casapalca polymetallic mine, 84 miles (134 km) west of Lima.
Last month, the state miner launched its piecemeal privatization with the sale of two of the company's major assets.
First, a Canadian consortium of Rio Algom Ltd and Inmet Mining Corp agreed to invest $2.52 billion over the next five years to become owner of the copper-rich Antamina prospect.

Also, Canada's Barrick Gold Corporation won the option to buy Peru's Quicay gold prospect by offering at an auction to pay $202 million should the company decide to develop the asset after feasibility studies.
The government plans to sell Centromin's seven mines, its La Oroya metallurgical complex, a railroad network, port facilities, four hydroelectric plants and several prospects by the middle of 1997.
